demo_bookmark_categories_ownership_check.name: demo_bookmark_categories_ownership_check

demo_bookmarks_interval_check.name: demo_bookmarks_interval_check
demo_bookmarks_interval_check.value: ("demo_bookmarks"."end_timestamp_seconds" IS NULL AND "demo_bookmarks"."peak_timestamp_seconds" IS NULL) OR ("demo_bookmarks"."end_timestamp_seconds" IS NOT NULL AND "demo_bookmarks"."peak_timestamp_seconds" IS NOT NULL AND "demo_bookmarks"."timestamp_seconds" <= "demo_bookmarks"."peak_timestamp_seconds" AND "demo_bookmarks"."peak_timestamp_seconds" <= "demo_bookmarks"."end_timestamp_seconds")

demo_bookmarks_provenance_check.name: demo_bookmarks_provenance_check
demo_bookmarks_provenance_check.value: ("demo_bookmarks"."origin" = 'manual' AND "demo_bookmarks"."analysis_run_id" IS NULL) OR ("demo_bookmarks"."origin" = 'automatic' AND "demo_bookmarks"."analysis_run_id" IS NOT NULL)
